albums.blurb: Satoshi Ashikawa was a Tokyo composer and sound designer who founded the Sound Process label and its Wave Notation series to document Japan's then-new kankyō ongaku, or environmental music, publishing Hiroshi Yoshimura's Music for Nine Post Cards before this, his only album; he died in a car accident in 1983 at age thirty. Its six unhurried pieces for harp, piano, flute and vibraphone — the vibraphone handled in part by percussionist Midori Takada — follow Erik Satie's furniture-music idea: Ashikawa intended the record to be heard casually, "as a musical landscape or a sound object."
albums.reception: The original 1982 LP became one of the most sought-after Japanese ambient records before WRWTFWW Records gave it its first-ever reissue in 2019, and Ashikawa's "Still Space" opens Light in the Attic's Kankyō Ongaku compilation, which was Grammy-nominated for Best Historical Album.

albums.blurb: Doechii is Jaylah Hickmon, a Tampa rapper who in 2022 became the first female rapper signed to Top Dawg Entertainment, the Los Angeles label behind Kendrick Lamar and SZA. Alligator Bites Never Heal, her third mixtape, arrived in August 2024 after years of viral singles and stretches her agile, theatrically versatile rapping across nineteen tracks of jazz- and boom-bap-leaning production, led by the singles "Nissan Altima", "Boom Bap" and "Denial Is a River".
albums.reception: It won Best Rap Album at the 2025 Grammys — making Doechii only the third woman to take the category, after Lauryn Hill with the Fugees and Cardi B — and later climbed to No. 10 on the Billboard 200.

albums.blurb: Nilüfer Yanya is a West London singer and guitarist of Turkish, Irish and Barbadian descent who broke through with her eclectic 2019 debut Miss Universe. PAINLESS, her second album, released on ATO Records in March 2022, narrows that record's stylistic sprawl into twelve taut songs of wiry guitar, drum machines and close-mic'd vocals, made largely with Wilma Archer, who also produced the debut, alongside Bullion, Andrew Sarlo and her bandmate Jazzi Bobbi.
albums.reception: Pitchfork scored it 8.4, making it her second consecutive album to earn the site's Best New Music designation, and later placed it on its 100 Best Albums of 2022 list.
